         ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM FLAVUM

       Yellow Sulphuret of Arsenic. Orpiment

      (ARSENIC TRISULPH.)


Needle pricks from within outwards in chest; also on forehead, right side.
      Sticking behind ear. Difficult respiration. Skin chafed about genitals.


Leucoderma and squamous syphilides. Sciatica and pain around the knee.



Relationship.--    Arsenic sulph rub
      (influenza with intense catarrhal symptoms, great prostration and high temperature, purulent
      discharges, psoriasis, acne,   and sciatica  . Chilly even
      before a fire. Itching in various parts. Pellagra).



Dose.--  Third trituration.
